reviewer: Codex research review under user authorization; not independent human content review
scope: Two paired seeds, story only, up to 100 updates per arm; exact target budget 8192 plus final microbatch overshoot. Frozen existing individual is read only by memory bridge. No initial language weights, focus, SFT, or final test.
basis: P28 content sample and P54 bounded story source review; this review binds the new exact plan but does not expand the P54 limit.
limitations: P28 sampled 64 stories, not the full corpus; translated synthetic fiction has known quality and safety defects.
Existing lexical isolation audit does not prove semantic isolation or exclusion from all prior sources.
100 updates and two seeds do not establish convergence or generalization; GPU cost and numerical determinism remain to be measured.
The two arms differ in memory inputs, parameter count and computation; NLL differences cannot isolate the cause.
